name: budabit-calendar-widget
description: BudaBit inline widget for featuring community calendar events

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.widget:publish:after:dry-run: pnpm widget:build:after && budabit-publish --event dist/widget-after/event.json --dry-run --relay ${COMMUNITY_RELAYS:?Set COMMUNITY_RELAYS to the tagged community relay URLs}
scripts.widget:publish:before:dry-run: pnpm widget:build:before && budabit-publish --event dist/widget-before/event.json --dry-run --relay ${COMMUNITY_RELAYS:?Set COMMUNITY_RELAYS to the tagged community relay URLs}
scripts.widget:publish:after:blossom: pnpm widget:build:after && budabit-publish --event dist/widget-after/event.json --upload-first --blossom ${BLOSSOM_SERVER:-https://blossom.primal.net} --artifact dist/index.html --relay ${COMMUNITY_RELAYS:?Set COMMUNITY_RELAYS to the tagged community relay URLs}
scripts.widget:publish:before:blossom: pnpm widget:build:before && budabit-publish --event dist/widget-before/event.json --upload-first --blossom ${BLOSSOM_SERVER:-https://blossom.primal.net} --artifact dist/index.html --relay ${COMMUNITY_RELAYS:?Set COMMUNITY_RELAYS to the tagged community relay URLs}
